description: This course explores Jesus through Scripture and Christian tradition using an Indigenous and decolonizing lens. The course examines how colonial histories have shaped dominant interpretations of Jesus and the impact of those interpretations on Indigenous and marginalized communities. Centering Indigenous voices, students encounter Jesus as healer, relative, and liberator, grounded in relationships to land, community, and justice. Through engagement with biblical texts and diverse perspectives, the course invites reflection on how these understandings reshape faith, identity, and belonging.
